assessment: Revised contract is technically coherent and bounded enough for explicit human browser-surface/private-disclosure direction. All five source-backed review findings are resolved. This is readiness only, not human approval, implementation authorization or acceptance.
scopeAssessment: Conditional existing Export with uncited direct compatibility, exact-owner metadata plus fresh notes-only consent, clean-saved editor guards and captured late-response/Blob handling can reuse the accepted headless qualifier without schema/store/renderer/provider authority changes. Private source/admin boundaries remain distinct from existing uncited CRUD permissions.

resolvedFindings.issue: POST-only admission omitted full saved-document/catalog inspect work.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Both GET metadata and POST render share process2/owner1 finite no-queue admission; slots cover actual work only, never confirmation.

resolvedFindings.issue: Shared browser consumption limit could silently change accepted uncited downloads.
resolvedFindings.resolution: New64MiB server/browser cap applies only to notes POST; uncited legacy size behavior remains unchanged and unqualified.

resolvedFindings.issue: Compact server metadata did not explicitly bound client error/metadata consumption or exact validation.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Actual8KiB UTF-8 JSON metadata/error bound, exact schema/project/safe counters/count validation before modal, static error allowlist, no-store/omit/redirect:error.

resolvedFindings.issue: Existing CORS can short-circuit before private parser headers/method handling.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Raw-path private headers precede short-circuiting middleware; explicit non-disclosing OPTIONS exception and scoped static late errors preserve CORS policy.

resolvedFindings.issue: Independent button instances can each start conflicting dialogs despite per-button refs.
resolvedFindings.resolution: One synchronously claimed flow per Workspace/SceneViewer scope across all triggers, owner-only release and no competing modal starts.

technicalBasis.topic: Canonical snapshot and private owner authority
technicalBasis.assessment: Inspect and render remain separate accepted operations; exact saved counters re-enter one owner/document/catalog snapshot on every POST. Strict new Bearer binding cannot inherit permissive local downgrade/admin/cookie behavior.

Live engine/draft/save/copy/restore/reload refs and route epochs provide relevant seams. New synchronous auth generations and export guards must be implemented; existing generic button/modal are insufficient. Read-only status is not proof of saved state, and nested dialog layering/traps require actual browser evidence.

Early raw private headers/parser and late errors are implementable without CORS widening. New response limits/admission concern only the private family; ordinary uncited generation/size/auth compatibility is explicitly preserved rather than falsely certified.

focusedValidationAssessment: After direction, use the selected real HTTP private-boundary/PPTX checks with focused fault fakes, production controller lifecycle/body-limit challenges, one serial Chrome file with real download/keyboard/draft/race/screenshots/canvas evidence, and one reused build. Reuse accepted unchanged J6-1 storage/native/visual evidence; no old matrix or service recreation is warranted. Amend inventory before any adapter/qualifier change.

humanDirection.requiredDecision: Approve or revise conditional existing Export, clean-saved-only editor policy and exact-owner browser/HTTP notes disclosure of complete titles/full URLs including private queries; downloaded retention, unassessed support, long printed-note overflow, no automatic save/commit/retry and offline validation limits must remain explicit.
humanDirection.notImplied: No implementation, product execution, public/private HTTP disclosure, activation, deployment or dependent feature authority. Accepted J6-1 and nextCandidate.authorized:false remain unchanged.

executed.description: Read-only source/Git/document inspection and lightweight review artifact consistency only; no product behavior or visual evidence executed for planning.

limitations: No working UI/HTTP behavior, accessibility, visual, native or security pass is claimed from planning inspection.
Implementation must establish synchronous auth-transition generation and live guard behavior; token/email equality alone cannot establish ABA safety.
New family slots are process-local without hard generation deadlines;64MiB is a complete-output limit rather than a pre-generation asset-memory bound.
Legacy uncited size/auth/asset behavior remains outside the new private-path resource/security guarantee.
Downloaded notes cannot be revoked by source clear/delete; long printed notes can overflow and claim support remains not-assessed.
No runtime/schema/store/renderer changes are proposed; accepted J6-1 remains the baseline.

documentChecks.description: Lightweight file/JSON/Git-ref/delta/anchor checks only; no product tests or network Git command.
